notes.title: Big Trouble In Little Chimney is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
I'm really excited to announce that the [b]Big Trouble In Little Chimney[/b] is OUT NOW!

Grab your Shotgun, finish your hot punch and don't forget your mission: Save the Christmas! 🎄

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072710/Big_Trouble_in_Little_Chimney/

Even though the game is finished, I will continue to gather your suggestions to improve the game. If anyone has ideas about what they'd like to see, I'd love to hear them.

Thank you to everyone who supported me and my game during the development. Thanks for all your suggestions and feedback, you're all awesome!

And special thanks to my lovely wife Silvia for her GREAT patience :)

Have fun, folks!

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 25, 2023
notes.content:
[h3]The following updates have been implemented:[/h3]

[b]Added[/b]: Bonus description table to the Menu >> How To Play section
[b]Added[/b]: Sound fx for critical hit (you need to have Lucky Sticker on your robot)
[b]Added[/b]: Red flashing effect for crosshair if you make a critical hit.
[b]Added[/b]: Option to reset your Hi-Score to the Settings menu
[b]Changed[/b]: Player health from 10HP to 25HP (The health bar appears only if your shield is depleted - it's behind the shield)
[b]Fixed[/b]: Police car sirene bug


Happy gaming!

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 5, 2023
notes.content:
[h3]They Came From The Sky 2 is getting Out of Early Access next week![/h3]

I feel the game is completed, but I will continue to gather your suggestions to improve the game. If anyone has good ideas about what they'd like to see, I'd love to hear them. :)

Thanks for all your suggestions and feedback, you're all awesome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723828/d959db3fb0eb53d024c5f9064ebb7d2cda83563c.gif[/img]
[h3]The following updates have been implemented:[/h3]

[b]Added two NEW unlockable upgrades into the Tech Lab[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Lucky Sticker "42"[/b] - 10% chance to critical hit
[*] [b]Personal Transporter[/b] - Teleport yourself to the middle of the city where you started.
(You can't use it during a boss fight)
[/list]
[b]Added[/b] some info about controls in the Main menu - Help section
[b]Changed [/b]and improved crosshair movement on Xbox360 controller
[b]Fixed [/b]some small isues with falling lanterns
[b]Fixed [/b]player homing missile. Missiles was destroyed near the end of the left or right side of the screen.

Have fun, folks!  Wishing you all the best for 2023!

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 23, 2022
notes.content:
[h3]The following updates have been implemented:[/h3]

[b]Added[/b]: New unlockable area - Fun Park!
[b]Added[/b]: New unlockable area - Chinatown!
[b]Added[/b]: A lot of new buildings like Ferris wheel, carousel, tearoom and much more!
[b]Added[/b]: A lot of new destroyable decorations.
[b]Added[/b]: New "enemy" unit - Clown (Who likes clowns? ...me no)
[b]Added[/b]: New "enemy" unit - Man in straw hat
[b]Added[/b]: New deadly "weapon" Chinese lantern (Yes, you can use it as a deadly fire trap.)
[b]Added[/b]: Some new nice sound FX
[b]Changed[/b]: Falling enemies or birds can now kill pedestrians or infantry down on the street. Hell yes! It's really fun! :D
[b]Fixed[/b]: Enemy projectiles sometimes disappeared and was invisible  if enemy was near the end of the left or right side of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723828/b0b4a55aa3b14119029d9889e1871f8ef9633f31.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723828/59afba5f85624fe067f7f3721d42259310809d93.png[/img]

Happy gaming! and Merry Christmas! :)

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - December 5, 2022
notes.content:
[h3]The following updates have been implemented:[/h3]

[b]Added[/b]: New building - Night Disco Club
[b]Added[/b]: Two New "enemies" - Disco dancers :D
[b]Added[/b]: Flying music note for Elvises (for better visibility)
[b]Added[/b]: Some great people to the credits screen
[b]Changed[/b]: In Sphere mode, Police cars and Jeeps are now destroyable on 1 hit
[b]Fixed[/b]: Blackhole now suck also suicide Bombermans
[b]Fixed[/b]: "Levitating bug" Some enemies after hit by the DNA drone stucked in the sky.
[b]Fixed[/b]: Homing missile "loop" bug.
[b]Fixed[/b]: Bonus balloons "layer" bug.
[b]Fixed[/b]: Invisible bonus make you invisible also for vehicles not only for infantry like before
[b]Fixed[/b]: Version number from 1.x to 0.x (because it's only in beta stage)

Two new areas [spoiler](chinatown and fun fair - amusement park)[/spoiler] will be added into the next update! [spoiler]Get ready for a Ferris Wheel and exploding Clowns![/spoiler] Stay tuned!


Happy gaming! :)

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - November 7, 2022
notes.content:
[h1]The following updates have been implemented:[/h1]

[b]Added[/b]: New bonus, mini Black Hole. Yes, it sends people to another "better" dimension.
[b]Added[/b]: Surprise "hmm" ?! sign for all enemies near you if you are invisible.
[b]Changed[/b]: All enemy units that are currently offscreen and not visible in the Boss fight are destroyed, so you can focus on the boss fight itself.
[b]Changed[/b]: Homing missile has been improved to fly more realistic.
[b]Fixed[/b]: Bomberman is now destroyable by melting beam.
[b]Fixed[/b]: Civilians in the windows are now destroyable by melting beam.
[b]Fixed[/b]: Zeppelin and Birds are now destroyable by homing missiles.

Happy gaming! :)

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - October 28, 2022
notes.content:
[h2]The following updates have been implemented:[/h2]

[b]Added[/b]: Special bonus Balloons! Try to hit Balloons on the sky. Each balloon will drop a random bonuses.
[b]Added[/b]: Bonus to restore Full HP
[b]Added[/b]: Bonus that make you invisible for all enemy units.
[b]Added[/b]: Bonus that slows down time to 50%
[b]Added[/b]: Bonus that turns your standard cannon into a melting gun.
[b]Added[/b]: Bonus with which you call a support bombing UFO unit.
[b]Added[/b]: Superhero! Beware of this flying fly, you can't destroy him! Instead use a squat to avoid him!
[b]Added[/b]: New Stun mode/animation for alien if Superhero hits you.
[b]Added[/b]: You can now use the middle mouse button for Abduct Beam
[b]Fixed[/b]: Some graphic issues
[b]Fixed[/b]: Polic officers will not spawn during the Boss combat

The next update will bring another great new bonuses. Stay tuned!

Happy gaming! :)

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - October 19, 2022
notes.content:
[b]The following updates have been implemented:[/b]

It seems that the Boss "Bludr" airship was too much overpowered, so it was rebalanced.



[b]Changed[/b]: Boss HP from 999 to 300. Also two of the cannons have now reduced their damage from 7 to 5

[b]Changed[/b]: New Enemies (humans) will not spawn while you fight with the Boss

[b]Added[/b]: Each New boss have +100HP, so it will be stronger and stronger with each unlocked area.

[b]Don't forget:[/b] If you want to unlock a new area, you need to beat the Boss! The boss always appears after 150+ killed humans.



It's just a small update but very important, i think ;)

Happy gaming! :)

@FobTi
